node.title: The sharp rate-half two-petal guarded cell is algebraically nonempty
node.statement: On the smooth H_32 subgroup of F_97^* with the sharp rate-half analogue (n,k,ell,M,b,d)=(32,16,4,4,1,5), an exact adversarial label-ratio census over 50 deterministic maximal source layouts finds 41 nonempty layouts and 71 primitive exact two-full-petal contributors, with maximum five in one layout. Seed 3 supplies an explicit contributor. Thus no field-independent algebraic argument can declare the sharp background-guarded equations empty. This finite witness has root excess three and does not prove an asymptotic FPC5 family or refute polynomial payment.
